scope: Residual arithmetic/state semantics only; no candidate implementation, numerical experiment, source promotion or execution authorization.

unchanged_profile.weights: G128 asymmetric packed INT4; native GEMM nibble order [0,4,1,5,2,6,3,7]; qzero adjustment 0; FP16 scales.
unchanged_profile.local_S0_S17: finite AND (abs_error <= 1/8 OR (relative_error < 1/1000 AND ordered_FP16_ULP <= 1)); denominator=max(abs(independent local FP16 reference),2^-14).
unchanged_profile.local_operand_authority: Authenticated actual producer data and independently authenticated canonical operator/control metadata; local agreement never excuses wrong residual ownership, cache identity or unsupported arithmetic semantics.
unchanged_profile.global_S18: Original independently propagated binary64 r; q(r)=min over finite binary16 h of abs(h-r); exact excess=abs(actual-r)-q(r) <= 1/8. Finite operands and abs(r)<=65504 mandatory. No clamping, re-anchoring or candidate-derived global reference.
unchanged_profile.legacy: Preserve legacy/v2 policies, defaults and all FAILs. Whole-FP16 S0-S18 trajectory comparisons remain truthful v3 diagnostics, not replacement mandatory gates.
unchanged_profile.later_modes: No W8A16, BF16/FP16 or other mode is implemented or admitted. Future modes require explicit numerical and state contracts; this rejection is not a universal restriction on their interfaces.

accepted_prefix.scope: Actual P0/L0-L8 in the current single-round/v3 lineage; not the older full-model tail lineage.
accepted_prefix.binding_authority: The retained L9 manifest parent binding and the genuine prerequisite reviews; no fresh prefix admission or replay.

witness_diagnostic_only.interpretation: Correct single RNE16 of these actual inputs is 1581. This is not a broken final-adder diagnosis.

canonical_suffix_control.retained_conclusion: All four complete canonical value suffixes still produce 662d at the retained witness and fail the unchanged global gate. No demonstrated surgical repair.
canonical_suffix_control.limit: Nested same-input software controls, not isolated RTL patches, unique upstream localization or a proof that every locally admissible implementation fails. No rerun in this mission.

current_general_recurrence.domain: Every valid layer l, token position p and hidden coordinate i; H, O and D are authenticated finite binary16 producer values.
current_general_recurrence.S13_S17: The MLP consumes actual binary16 R at S13, through the unchanged norm2/gate/up/SiLU/down operators, producing binary16 D. It does not consume the unrounded H+O.
current_general_recurrence.S18: H[l+1,p,i]=RNE16(value(H[l,p,i])+value(O[l,p,i])+value(D[l,p,i])) with an exact three-term sum and one final rounding.
current_general_recurrence.intralayer_equivalence: With e=(value(H)+value(O))-value(R), exact R+e+D equals H+O+D. Computing that transient e is only a refactoring of the already implemented single-round final residual, not a new repair.
current_general_recurrence.cross_layer_state: Only the binary16 hidden vector crosses the layer boundary. There is no admitted residual-error carry.
current_general_recurrence.cross_position_state: Own-layer FP16 K/V plus validity, context and control state persist. Residual error is not an autoregressive state variable shared between token positions.
current_general_recurrence.exact_accumulation: The frozen core decodes each finite FP16 operand to signed 41-bit Q24, sign-extends to signed 43-bit Q24, adds exactly, then applies the binary16 RNE converter. This transient internal width does not widen the activation ABI.

rejected_extension.kind: Mathematical counterproposal only; no implementation or usable state ABI is defined.
rejected_extension.state: Additional exact dyadic C[l,p,i], owned by a single candidate arithmetic history and token position, never by a witness, cache slot alone or reference output.
rejected_extension.root: C[0,p,i]=0 only at an authenticated FP16 model activation root. This is not a license to introduce C=0 at an arbitrary retained layer boundary and claim compensated-prefix equivalence.
full_residual_variant: R=RNE16(T); existing FP16-boundary MLP produces D from R
final_only_variant: Keep S12 and its MLP inputs unchanged
rejected_extension.not_a_global_reference: C accounts only for this candidate's own residual rounding. It is not original_binary64_hidden-H and cannot reconstruct primitive or nonlinear global-trajectory errors.
rejected_extension.finite_rounding: All named FP16 operands must be finite/known. RNE16 has ties-to-even and gradual underflow; any overflow/invalid state rejects the transaction. Exact mathematical C is not silently rounded, saturated or assigned an implementation width.
rejected_extension.reset_clear: A hypothetical extension must invalidate all carries with reset/clear and initialize them only at a real root, not retain them across unrelated positions, prompts or arithmetic lineages.
rejected_extension.restore: Every live carry would have to survive a compatible same-history save/restore exactly, including ownership and validity. Legacy snapshots lack an admitted carry field and cannot be migrated by invented zeros, reference differences or scratch-memory reinterpretation.
rejection_reasons: C discarded at every layer boundary reduces the final-only variant to the existing exact single-round recurrence and leaves the retained L9 rounding unchanged.
Nonzero C used at S12 changes the frozen canonical residual operand semantics; passing an error tolerance is not authorization to change that operator.
Persistent C used even only at S18 makes (H,C), rather than H alone, the residual activation state. Multiple FP16 words or host-side compensation do not avoid this effective state/profile extension.

The exact frozen public top has no residual-carry input/output and the generated simulator save ABI provides no admitted portable cross-layer carry. Reusing unused ports, encodings or scratch state is not compatibility.
Feeding H+C to RMSNorm/Q/K/V is a further activation-boundary change, not the existing FP16-input operator.

Selecting an initial C, bias, rounding mode or output from the known witness/global answer is forbidden. A general alternative with different rounding is still a new arithmetic policy requiring separate justification.
rejected_extension.claim_limit: Rejection under the current frozen W4A16 arithmetic/state contract, not proof that compensated arithmetic is impossible in another explicitly reviewed profile or that all principled W4A16 implementation repairs fail.

affected_cone_and_reuse.current_decision: No source, arithmetic, cache or state is changed; accepted L0-L8 and the failed L9 cone remain immutable. No affected cone is authorized to run.
affected_cone_and_reuse.hypothetical_global_carry: First additional state is produced at L0/P0/S18; accepted FP16-only prefix receipts do not admit this new carry history. With zero root carry, L0 numerical outputs can remain identical and are not automatically replayed.

hypothetical_first_numeric_changes.full_residual_variant: First possible carry use is L1/P0/S12, affecting S13-S18 and subsequent layers. Its own P0 Q/K/V precede this change.
hypothetical_first_numeric_changes.final_only_variant: First possible numerical change is L1/P0/S18; next-layer RMSNorm/Q/K/V and their descendant hidden/cache histories are affected.
hypothetical_first_numeric_changes.effective_hidden_to_nonlinear_variant: Using H+C as a nonlinear input first potentially changes L1/P0/S0 and that layer's Q/K/V. This is separately rejected activation widening.
hypothetical_first_numeric_changes.unrounded_residual_to_norm2_variant: Bypassing the S12 FP16 boundary first affects L0/P0/S13 even without cross-layer carry; it violates the frozen S13 input semantics.

affected_cone_and_reuse.reuse_boundary: Reuse authenticated outputs only where producer inputs, arithmetic, controls, finite/rounding rules and required state are unchanged. Byte-identical FP16 H does not establish carry identity. A new global recurrence cannot simply attach to accepted L8 using an invented C9.
affected_cone_and_reuse.local_restart_at_l9: For a final-only extension with C9=0, retained H/O/D give exactly the known FAIL; it does not recover any earlier rounding history. Nonzero C9 has no admitted source in the retained L8 interface.
affected_cone_and_reuse.kv_lineage: K/V is owned by layer, slot, position, canonical weights/RoPE and its actual hidden producer history. A same-layer residual-only change after K/V production need not change that P0 K/V, but later-layer K/V and all reachable later-position histories require separate compatibility analysis.
affected_cone_and_reuse.snapshot_lineage: Opaque Verilator snapshots bind the generated class layout, compiled parameters, binary/source closure and complete live state. Matching module ports, FP16 dtype or dimensions is insufficient for restoration.
affected_cone_and_reuse.historical_tail: The older 24-layer/token-358 tail and Q-only fixed-history candidate evidence are separate lineages, not carry initializers or downstream states for this prefix.
affected_cone_and_reuse.future_proof_requirement: An independently justified changed cone must identify the first changed producer and every reachable hidden/K/V dependency; preserve and reuse genuinely unaffected accepted data rather than replaying ancestors for metadata.

public_interface_and_control.ports: The entire exact frozen signature is normative by reference, not a guessed alias list. In particular load_f16_i, trace_f16_o and final_f16_o are 16-bit; no carry channel or hardware restore port exists.
public_interface_and_control.clock_reset: Rising-edge transfers; rst_ni is asynchronous active-low, clear_i synchronous active-high. Reset/clear return control to idle, invalidate activation/norm loads, zero context lengths, clear pending trace/done and invalidate cache valid bits. Cache payload RAM need not be physically zeroed; invalid entries are not valid state.
public_interface_and_control.rounding_zero_finite: Preserve exact residual accumulation and binary16 RNE ties-to-even/gradual underflow. At S18 an exactly zero sum is -0 only when all three operands are -0; otherwise +0. Nonfinite operands or FP16 overflow assert the core invalid indication; its placeholder output is not an admissible finite result. X/Z in participating data/control is rejected under the existing top/harness checks, never coerced into valid zero.
public_interface_and_control.handshake: Accept inputs and outputs only on valid/ready clock edges; hold pending payload/index/last under backpressure; never update arithmetic or persistent ownership merely because valid is held. Preserve coupled final/trace and done sequencing and existing fault behavior.
public_interface_and_control.reset_is_not_restore: P0 has empty own-layer prior KV and must not restore a predecessor snapshot. Later-position state must be an independently admitted compatible own-layer snapshot, restored idle with its actual context/validity. Clearing it would destroy the required context.
public_interface_and_control.compile_boundary: No compilation is performed for this non-executing rejection. Before a separately admitted first candidate attempt, freeze and compile the exact top/module/ports/parameters without aliases; compile success alone is not numerical correctness or ABI compatibility.

forbidden_executions: No software candidate, RTL edit, capture, replay, restore/eval or L10-L23 launch from this artifact.
No use of failed L9 output/snapshot as a continuation parent, even though its runtime/state checks passed.
No reference hidden/Q/K/V, local expected output or binary64-derived correction injected into execution.
No witness-conditioned bias, rounding, coordinate/layer exceptions, selected preferred outputs or calibration against the known answer.
No threshold/reference policy weakening, activation/KV widening, silent ABI migration or arithmetic/state lineage splice.
No changed global reference inputs; retain all original diagnostics, FAILs, freezes, sources and genuine reviews.
No token/full-model/dialogue, synthesis, PPA, FPGA, board, bitstream, deployed-hardware, commit or publication claim.

before_any_new_work: Normal independent Host Reviewer must assess this scoped rejection against the actual frozen recurrence, public signature and reviewed retained evidence. Engineer cannot self-approve; historical reviews do not approve this new spec.
A distinct general candidate requires a separately reviewed mathematical reason and a precise changed-source/operand/state cone, not another unchanged primitive-canonicalization experiment.

Any arithmetic-boundary, persistent residual-state or ABI extension needs explicit delegated-parent technical disposition and independent review before software candidate construction; this artifact grants none.

An independent oracle must be specified before candidate execution: canonical model/control authentication, independent implementation, exact rounding/finite rules and unchanged v3/global references. It must not import candidate arithmetic or construct expected values from candidate outputs.
State ownership, root initialization, cache dependencies, save layout and any reuse argument must be reviewed before restoring or forwarding state. Missing information blocks; no silent defaults.

Only a subsequently scoped, genuinely reviewed candidate can proceed to software evidence, then reviewed RTL changes/affected-cone execution under unchanged gates. A later numerical failure stops forwarding, regardless of local gate success.
future_regressions_not_run: General signed residuals, cancellation and all signed-zero combinations; subnormals, normal/binade ties and large/small operands; exact three-term versus accidental double rounding.
Finite limits, overflow, NaN/Inf, X/Z, invalid count/control, inclusive abs/excess budget and strict relative boundary; no success-shaped placeholder admission.
Reset/clear during idle and active transactions, backpressure stability, exactly-once consumption, no stale residual/load state, P0 no-restore and later-position own-layer context preservation.
Restored versus uninterrupted compatible execution, wrong layer/position/slot, missing carry, foreign arithmetic/source/generated ABI, truncated/invalid state and attempted A/B splice rejection.
All covered coordinates and stages, a real local arithmetic error, global drift despite local correctness, independent canonical metadata and producer identity failures, legacy/v2 preservation.
Retain the L9 same-input exact sum and four canonical-suffix FAILs as negative controls, never as witness-specific implementation rules; do not rerun them unchanged merely to restamp this spec.

failure_accounting.root_cause_hypothesis: Inherited FP16 hidden-state versus original-global trajectory discrepancy persists through the observed L9 residual. Canonical suffix controls rule out the tested same-input primitive corrections as a demonstrated remedy; they do not isolate every upstream cause.
failure_accounting.regression: Reuse the reviewed exact residual witness and all four complete canonical suffixes without recomputation.
failure_accounting.this_spec_result: Contract-compatibility rejection, not evaluator-no-execution reclassification of the actual L9 FAIL, a new numerical FAIL or an impossibility proof.
